hero.subtitle: Indian yoga, meditation, and wellness for body and spirit

about.title: The Lotus Path
about.subtitle: About Yoga Hoa Sen
about.body: Yoga Hoa Sen follows the Indian style of Tantra-Yoga symbolized by the peaceful lotus flower that rises from muddy waters to bloom in pristine beauty. Our practice helps you find clarity, peace, and radiance from within, in today's busy and hectic world.
about.body2: Founded in the 2000s in Saigon, we bring together experienced teachers from Vietnam and overseas, all united in the philosophy called Neo-Humanism from philosopher PR Sarkar.

hatha.name: Yoga Classes on Asanas
hatha.desc: Special exercises have an impact on the endocrine glands, joints, muscles, ligaments and nerves, helping to stabilize breathing and blood pressure, to comprehensively develop the practitioner's body and mind.

vinyasa.name: Social Service
vinyasa.desc: We participate is social service work through PROUT, RAWA, and other related organizations.

yin.name: Fasting and Detox
yin.desc: We hold fasting camps and detox workshops.

meditation.name: Meditation Classes
meditation.desc: Helps calm the central nervous system as well as heart rate, blood pressure and reduce stress. At the same time, increase intelligence, sharp intuition, increase generosity and openness.

prenatal.name: Master Unit
prenatal.desc: We have a 5 hectare land for use in agriculture and neo-humanistic education

kids.name: Natural Products
kids.desc: We sell natural and herbal products that are from Vietnam and India
